resources.string: Point your camera at a Telegram QR code
Point your camera at the QR code Telegram shows on your computer
Pingogram uses the camera only to read QR codes. Nothing the camera sees leaves your phone.
To scan with the camera, allow Pingogram to use it in the app\'s settings. You can also scan a QR code from an image.
This device has no camera Pingogram can use. You can scan a QR code from an image.
This QR code isn\'t a Telegram link
On your computer, open Telegram and choose to log in with a QR code, then scan the code it shows.
Never share it: someone may be trying to log in to your account.
This link leads nowhere you can see
Pingogram can\'t open this kind of link yet
Choose an image where the QR code is sharp and fills more of the picture.
